title: Historical Benchmark Reconciliation
description: Cross-phase comparison of B4 Balanced Accuracy between Phase 5.3.1/5.3.2 historical benchmarks and Phase 5.3.3.3 / Phase 5.3.3.4 reconstructed metrics.

comparisons.explanation: Fold mean BA matches historical reported benchmark to 4 decimal places. The pooled OOF BA differs from fold mean because macro recall averaging across folds with different class support is non-linear (Simpson's paradox).
